recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示雙側腳底散布多發、邊界不清的深棕色斑點並融合成斑片，位於足弓、前足與足跟，無明顯紅腫或水泡，僅有輕度乾燥脫皮；在接受免疫調節藥物治療的病人，符合藥物相關色素沉著。
features: Bilateral plantar hyperpigmentation with multiple dark-brown macules coalescing into patches
Asymmetric, poorly demarcated distribution over forefoot, arch and heel; toes also darkened
No blistering, erosion or marked erythema visible
Mild dry scaling of plantar skin
describe_en: Clinical photograph of both soles shows asymmetric, poorly demarcated dark-brown macules coalescing into patches across the forefoot, midfoot and heel, with mild dry scaling. No blistering, erosion or prominent inflammatory erythema is evident. In a patient treated with an immunomodulatory drug, the appearance is consistent with drug-associated acral hyperpigmentation; the diagnosis is clinical and depends on medication history.

ddx.vs: Hand-foot syndrome shows painful erythema, edema and desquamation on pressure areas rather than painless brown macules.
Melanoma is usually a solitary, asymmetric, variegated lesion that enlarges, whereas these are multiple bilateral symmetric-distribution macules.

ddx.dx: Addison disease or vitamin B12 deficiency pigmentation
ddx.vs: These cause similar acral pigmentation but are identified by systemic findings and laboratory testing (cortisol/ACTH, B12 level).
Syphilis produces copper-red scaly papules with systemic signs and positive serology, not flat dark-brown macules.
